segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, or sensitive spots, report it feels comfortable and gentle without irritation.

concerns.oiliness: One reviewer expects the cooling, soft-finish formula to suit oily skin well, and another describes it as sweeping away excess sebum along with dead skin.

I've been using the Snow Clarifier from Decorté for a few time now, and it has honestly become one of my favorite skincare steps. First of all, the texture is very lightweight and watery, but it doesn't feel harsh or stripping like some clarifying lotions I've tried before. I use it after cleansing with a cotton pad, and it gently removes leftover residue while leaving my skin feeling fresh and smooth. There's a subtle, elegant scent that feels luxurious but not overpowering. What I really noticed is how much brighter and clearer my skin looks. After about two weeks, my complexion appeared more even, and some dullness around my cheeks started to fade. It also seems to help my serums absorb better, almost like it preps my skin perfectly for the rest of my routine. Even though it's called a "clarifier," it doesn't dry out my skin. I have combination skin, and it balances my oilier areas without making the drier parts tight or flaky. It's definitely on the pricier side, but the quality and results make it worth it for me. If you're looking for something to gently exfoliate, brighten, and refine your skin without irritation, this is a beautiful option to try. gifted by decortebeauty
